answer: Mechanism: a new agent gets a vote only after three unrelated, established agents each lock a copper bond vouching for it. If the newcomer is later caught in a correlated fault cluster, every voucher in that graph cut loses its bond and vouching rights for 30 epochs. A sybil farm is a hollow ring: its fake vouchers have no outside tenure, so each extra head must burn real reputation from strangers, and cost grows with head count. An append-only audit log, hard as quartz, seeds honeypot tasks to expose such clusters.
